scope_note: Lower-case indigenous psychologies as a research approach must not be collapsed into research concerning legally or politically recognized Indigenous Peoples; the latter also carries people-specific rights and governance obligations.
statement: In the 2006 programmatic usage, indigenous psychologies are not synonymous with studies of Native peoples, ethnic groups, or the so-called Third World.
statement_zh: 在 2006 年的綱領性用法中，indigenous psychologies 並不等同於研究原住民族、族群或所謂第三世界。
